title: The Tech Download: Anduril CEO Brian Schimpf talks AI in warfare and manufacturing push
summary: In a recent episode of The Tech Download podcast, CNBC's Arjun Kharpal interviews Brian Schimpf, the CEO of Anduril, a defense technology company. Schimpf discusses the implications of artificial intelligence in warfare and its transformative potential in manufacturing processes. He emphasizes the importance of innovation in defense and how AI can enhance operational efficiency and decision-making. The conversation sheds light on the evolving landscape of military technology and the role of private companies in shaping future defense strategies.
